versions.subject: Haag's Crushed Shell: A Tale of CrushFTP Exploitation
versions.detection: `crushftp` | rex field=_raw "\\[HTTP:[^:]+:(?<username>[^:]+):(?<src_ip>[^\\]]+)\\]" | rex field=_raw "cmd:(?<cmd>[^\\*\\r\\n]+)" | where isnotnull(cmd) AND (match(cmd, "mesch\.exe") OR match(cmd, "b64exec") OR match(cmd, "fullinstall") OR match(cmd, "run")) | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by src_ip, username, cmd | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `crushftp_authentication_bypass_exploitation_filter`
